title: bro-lsp marks rust-analyzer ready on quiescent+error, surfacing as silent null results
wanted_capability: observe_rust_analyzer_status should evaluate status=="error" (mark_failed) before the quiescent early-return, and lsp.status should surface RA's status message/health so a broken workspace load reads as failed, not ready. Position requests against a failed workspace should error lsp_unavailable (fail closed per RX-V3) instead of returning null contents / "No references found at position".
missing_primitive: readiness state that distinguishes quiescent-healthy from quiescent-failed and fails closed on the latter
fallback_used: Validate lsp.* against non-lane checkouts or small fixtures only; treat null hover as a broken-workload signal, not a real "no info".
